subject: dsa
title: Range Sum Query
summary: Precompute prefix sums once. Then the sum of any range is prefix[r] minus prefix[l-1] — a single subtraction instead of a loop.
problem: After one preprocessing pass, answer any range-sum query in O(1).

steps.caption: We'll answer many 'sum from i to j' queries. Precompute once, then answer each in O(1).
Prefix sums: cell k holds the sum of the first k+1 values. Build it in one pass to [2, 6, 7, 10, 15].
Query: sum of indices 1 through 3. Take prefix[3] = 10, then subtract prefix[0] = 2 (everything before index 1).
10 - 2 = 8 — the range sum, with no loop. In general, range [l, r] = prefix[r] - prefix[l-1].
